header.welcomeBack: Welcome back, {{name}}. Here are your ledgers.

hero.subheadline: Budget Lens brings clarity to your money. Create ledgers, track every transaction, set category budgets, and see the real impact of inflation — all in one place.

features.heading: Everything you need to understand your money
features.subheading: From simple expense tracking to inflation-adjusted analytics, Budget Lens gives you the full picture without the complexity.

multiLedger.title: Multi-Ledger Management
multiLedger.desc: Create separate ledgers for personal, family, or business budgets. Keep every context organized and clearly separated.

categoryBudgets.title: Category Budgets
categoryBudgets.desc: Set spending limits per category and track progress visually. Know exactly when you're close to overspending.

inflation.title: Inflation-Adjusted Insights
inflation.desc: See your real purchasing power over time. Budget Lens adjusts amounts with CPI indexes so you know the true cost.

collaborative.title: Collaborative Budgeting
collaborative.desc: Invite family members or teammates to shared ledgers. Everyone stays aligned with full visibility.

multiCurrency.title: Multi-Currency Support
multiCurrency.desc: Manage budgets in ARS and USD simultaneously. Built for mixed-currency economies and cross-border finances.

paymentMethod.title: Payment Method Tracking
paymentMethod.desc: Track cash, bank transfers, wallets, and credit cards separately for a truly complete spending picture.

create.title: Create a Ledger
create.desc: Set up a budget ledger for any context — personal finances, household, a project, or your team.

add.title: Add Transactions
add.desc: Log income and expenses with categories, payment methods, and installment support built in.

gain.title: Gain Clarity
gain.desc: See where your money goes with clear summaries, budget progress, and inflation-adjusted real amounts.

secure.title: Secure by design
secure.body: Your data stays yours. No third-party sharing, no ads, no compromises.

inflation.title: Inflation-aware
inflation.body: Built for economies where purchasing power changes. Every amount has a real value.

teams.title: Built for teams
teams.body: Whether it's just you or your entire household, Budget Lens scales to your needs.

cta.heading: Ready to take control of your finances?
cta.body: Join Budget Lens and start seeing your money with clarity — for free, today.
